addresses.note: Mirror of the Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board (Maa- ja Ruumiamet) address data system (ADS) extract. The official download portal at xgis.maaamet.ee/adsavalik/ads has moved to the JS-rendered aks.geoportaal.ee/aks app; this mirror republishes the same 'väljavõte' CSV extract (filename prefix vv1_) on an ongoing basis. As of 2026-09 the extract's column headers are all lowercase.
